items.html: However, the last Sefira of the six Sefirot of Yetzira is called the Malchut of Yetzira, the Nukva of ZA of Yetzira, which now is the sixth Sefira of the world of Beria. And there is the secret of Trans-Jordan, the place of the children of Gad and the children of Reuven. And it is the aspect of the Malchut of Yetzira of that time, together with all the first three of Assiya of that time, which are now the four lower Sefirot of Beria.
